inputs.prompt: Create ONE 14.3-second edited sequence with five DISTINCT film shots in exact order; each shot fills the screen, never a grid. <Picture 1> is the opening composition and the sole visual authority: a hand-drawn Paris fashion-design workshop where Claire (dark wavy hair, hair clips, gray striped sweater, headphones around her neck, backpack) works on dark fabric with scissors on the left, and her classmate (dark hair, black top, beige apron) rests her chin on her hand on the right, at the same shared table. <Picture 2> is the exact Claire character design for identity and clothing. Preserve the referenced hand-drawn 2D style, muted colors and stable proportions. SHOT 1, 0.0-2.2 seconds: medium shot, both students work around the shared table on the same dark fabric design, a briefly cooperative atmosphere. CUT. SHOT 2, 2.2-4.2 seconds: close insert on the hands, scissors and the dark fabric at the worktable; one cutting motion severs a crucial portion and the detached edge falls against the table. CUT. SHOT 3, 4.2-7.0 seconds: medium-close shot, Claire pulls back the damaged fabric, faces the classmate and delivers one short angry line with a complete, forceful but controlled torso action. CUT. SHOT 4, 7.0-9.7 seconds: locked medium-wide shot on the same table, same screen axis; the classmate goes quiet, sets down her tool once, turns and walks out of frame, leaving a visible empty place. CUT. SHOT 5, 9.7-14.3 seconds: locked close shot of Claire alone by the table; she parts her lips as if to explain, raises one hand halfway, cannot speak, closes her lips and slowly lowers that same hand, then holds still in the quiet workshop. Clear hard editorial cuts, restrained emotion. No dialogue audio, text, subtitles, invented characters, costume changes, face redesign, red hair, magic effects, photorealism, 3D, split screens, storyboard grid or extra fingers.
